paras: Euspondylus nellycarrillae is a species of lizard in the subfamily Cercosaurinae of the family Gymnophthalmidae. The species is endemic to Peru.
The specific name, nellycarrillae, is in honor of Peruvian herpetologist Nelly Carrillo de Espinoza.
Euspondylus nellycarrillae is found in Huánuco Region, Peru.
The preferred natural habitat of Euspondylus nellycarrillae is forest, at elevations of 2,480–3,100 m (8,140–10,170 ft).
